verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, so neither is better. Both use a sensible left-to-right banner structure (headline, copy, product, CTA), but they share the same flaws. The product can is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail with an unreadable 'SOLSTICE' label. The legal line under the button is microscopic and fails legibility. 'Every mixed case of Solstice sparkling.' sits almost against '20% off' while a large dead gap opens before the product. 'WEEKEND ONLY' is very small and pushed toward the top edge.
